title: bodySeed
body:
## bodySeed

Start an editable PartDesign Body from an earlier checked solid, retaining the source link and original geometry.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Make the seed the first member of an empty Body. The source must be an external solid, not another Body member.
- Import Placement is Body-local; optional Body frame places the finished part in world space. Assembly mounts and components use Body-local coordinates.
- Native Placement expressions are compiled policy. Authored expressions, arbitrary foreign FCStd histories and the legacy readSTEP reader are refused.

Native binding: `PartDesign::FeatureBase`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | one node | yes | `body` |
| `source` | one node | yes | `solid` |

Options: none.
